title: In-session Workflow scan+evolve playbook: references/prometheus-workflow.md + SKILL.md routing
description: New references/prometheus-workflow.md plus a short SKILL.md Prometheus-section update: when in a Claude Code session with the Workflow tool, route 'Rick evolve'/'prometheus scan' through in-session workflow orchestration — parallel category scanners with structured-output schemas, one independent verifier per candidate that discards scanner self-scores and re-scores, serial `ingest` per survivor, evolve via ranked `evolve --only` + post-apply diff reviewer (demote-only). Plain CLI remains the headless/sleepy/cron fallback; nested claude -p ultracode rejected.
proposed_changes: Write references/prometheus-workflow.md (full playbook) and update the Prometheus section of SKILL.md with routing rules. Hard rules: never write .cto/prometheus/ directly, ingest is the only sanctioned write path, MAX_AUTO_APPLIES_PER_RUN=3 preserved.
